liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Casey Jones** (4 reviews, 1 other source): Casey Jones shakes up an otherwise typical second set for the era; Casey Jones coming out of Space is the one standout; the rest is judged average [5][10][17][18][19]
- **Corrina** (3 reviews): Corrina served as a spacey second-set opener, with trance-like repetitive keyboards foreshadowing the rest of the show; Corrina and Picasso Moon both rock [13][14][20]
- **Space** (2 reviews, 1 other source): Train horn teases in Space had been happening since spring tour; Shenandoah emerging from Space was amazing [5][11][19]
- **Baba O'Riley** (2 reviews): Baba O'Riley is a breakout with unusual placement as encore; reviewer wishes it stayed in the rotation; Encore was a surprise but not fully successful musically [17][19]
- **Friend Of The Devil** (1 review): Friend of the Devil is played at a leisurely pace [14]
- **Mexicali Blues** (1 review): Mexicali Blues, Maggie's Farm and Picasso Moon were highlights of a long first set [11]
- **Maggie's Farm** (1 review): Maggie's Farm is singled out as a favorite of a solid first set [18]
- **Row Jimmy** (1 review): Jerry adds a very spacey Row Jimmy [14]

## Setlist highlights

- **Casey Jones**: back after 455 archived shows (2013 days) [21]
- **Baba O'Riley**: rare: 12 archived performances [21]
- **Tomorrow Never Knows**: rare: 12 archived performances [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1992-06-20.dsbd.lynn.33953.sbeok.flac1648** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 157 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1992-06-20.sbd.fix.leavy.93996.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 156 min; rated 3.67/5 by 3 [3]
- **gd92-06-20.dsbd.gardner.2207.sbefail.shnf**: source not stated; 20 songs; 157 min; rated 3.92/5 by 39 [4]. Said about its sound: Recording is excellent, apart from a dip in level during Corrina; Corrina contains a level change, as in the other circulating shn set [4][10]
- **gd1992-06-20.dsbd.miller.32488.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 156 min; rated 4/5 by 10 [2]

## Around the show

- First set is dominated by Vince's keyboard playing [10]
- Listener sat at the top of the dugout, right side facing the stage [11]
- Listener arrived as Promised Land ended; others raved about the set, and Bruce played accordion [13]
- Listener's birthday; the weather was perfect [13]
- Listener and brother drove from Charlotte to the show; it made them fall for the Dead [20]
- Steve Miller joined for One More Saturday Night, Baba O'Riley and Tomorrow Never Knows [5]
- Reviewer finds 1992-95 material good but not matching earlier years [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1992-06-20.dsbd.lynn.33953.sbeok.flac1648**: taped by Mark Lynn; transferred by Mark Lynn; source: Master Soundboard DAT @ 48KHZ->DAT x 4.Conversion [1]
- **gd1992-06-20.sbd.fix.leavy.93996.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Edited by Tim Leavy; source: SBD -> Dat -> CD [3]. Also: Fix of the Corrina track from Charlie Miller's source, using Adobe Audition 3.0 to smooth level fluctuations [3]
- **gd92-06-20.dsbd.gardner.2207.sbefail.shnf**: source: DSBD has same change in level in Corinna as mentioned on the other shn set in circulation [4]
- **gd1992-06-20.dsbd.miller.32488.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller and Paul Scotton; source: SBD -> Dat -> CD [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Fred Strame Grateful Dead: [1992-06-20 Robert F. Kennedy Stadium, Washington, DC, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1992-06-20-robert-f-kennedy-stadium-washington-dc-usa/) [22]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Robert F. Kennedy Stadium - June 20, 1992](https://www.dead.net/show/june-20-1992) [23]
